title: CLO 2025.0 - Materials
description: This video will introduce the functional updates related to materials. In addition, other feature optimizations can help streamline your workflow.

summary: ```markdown # CLO 2025.0 - Materials ## Introduction In this video, I will introduce the relevant functions of the material for you. ## Improvements in Version 2025 In the previous version, we could only attach one point on the component. In the 2025 version, we have improved the interaction between the component and the clothing. Now, we can attach multiple points of the same component to the clothing. For complex component styles, we may need to attach two or more points of the component. ### Component Selection and Placement First, we can use the option to move the tool to select the component. Then, click the quick arrangement button. Place the component near the ideal position of the clothing. This is a simple placement process and will not produce any adhesion effect. ### Tool and Component Integration In the new version, the tool is combined with the component. The operation is similar to fixing the plate to the plate. Using the tool, we can click the point on the component. Then, click the point to be attached to the clothing. The first group of points is created. We can use the same method to attach the second group of points on the component. These points will be displayed in dark red and virtual. ### Simulation Results Let's see the result after opening the simulation. The two points on the component are perfectly integrated on the clothing. If necessary, you can also attach more points on the component. If you want to edit the position of the armor, please use the edit armor tool. You can edit in 3D and 2D windows. Just select the point of the armor and drag its position. Open the simulation and check the effect. ### Deleting Armor To delete the armor, just select it. Then right-click to delete on the menu or press the delete button. Therefore, you can now decide to attach one point or more points according to the component type to achieve a more realistic simulation effect. ## PBR Stickers and Naming Method In the 2025.0 version, you can follow the designated naming method. After adding the pattern to the text, automatically import other PBR stickers. First, before importing PBR stickers, we need to store all PBR stickers in the same folder. Then, change the name of the sticker according to the name of the file. We need to follow the name of the image, the draft line, and the name of the PBR sticker. These three components form the image naming rule to ensure that all PBR stickers can be correctly imported. ### Naming Rules The image name should be placed at the beginning and can be self-defined. Each PBR sticker uses the same image name, allowing the software to identify that these stickers belong to the same group. The draft line is positioned behind the image name and in the middle of the entire name. The PBR sticker name should be placed at the end. The name of the PBR sticker also needs to follow the naming rule as it will affect the import position of the picture in the Clover attribute editor. To facilitate this, you can use the content shown now to name your own PBR stickers. You can also refer to the official website for detailed information. ## Importing PBR Stickers In the attribute editor, let's import the text sticker. Click the browse button, find the folder where the PBR stickers are placed, select the text, then click open. At this time, you will see a pop-up message asking whether to continue. Click yes. In the attribute editor, add the text sticker and other PBR stickers at the same time. Click no, and just the text sticker will be added; other PBR stickers in the attribute editor will not be imported or updated. Here, we click yes, and you can see that the text sticker and other PBR stickers are added to the corresponding position. ### Updating Text Stickers You can also import new text stickers to replace the existing text stickers in the attribute editor. Other related PBR stickers will be added and updated at the same time. You can also add other PBR stickers in addition to the fabric using this new function. For example, stickers, self-defined name lines, and so on. With this new function, you can upload all PBR stickers at once and paste the picture. ## Text Editor Improvements The following is the 2025 version about the improvement of the text editor. There are two points in total. One is that you can provide more picture format options to use the format that you need to save the picture. The other is to support the storage of combined layer images. ### Adding and Saving Images Open the text editor, we can add more pictures and edit these pictures to achieve various design effects. After editing and adjusting the settings, click Save Picture to save the picture result. Users can click below the window to select the picture format. You can export the selected picture to the desired format, now supporting PNG, JPEG, and TIFF three file formats. Therefore, you can choose the file format according to your needs. ### Layer Image Storage You can also choose whether to save the combined layer image. After selecting the layer image to be saved and combined, add an additional layer image to the combined layer images. At the same time, the separated text layer images will be stored normally. If you cancel the selection, only separate single text layer images are stored in the existing rules. This is the same as the default storage result before. Here, click OK after setting up. Open the storage folder, and you can see the single layer image and combined image stored. ## Conclusion By providing multiple image formats and new storage options, when users use the text editor to design the text, they have more flexibility. ```
